mapper.select: SELECT AVG(cpu_per) AS "cpuAvg", MAX(cpu_per) AS "cpuMax", (SELECT to_char(tm,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY cpu_per DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS "cpuMaxTime", AVG(mem_us) AS "redisMemAvg", MAX(mem_us) AS "redisMemMax", (SELECT to_char(tm,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY mem_us DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS "redisMemMaxTime", AVG(ops) AS "qpsAvg", MAX(ops) AS "qpsMax", (SELECT to_char(tm,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY ops DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS "qpsMaxTime", AVG(cmd_latency) AS "latencyAvg", MAX(cmd_latency) AS "latencyMax", (SELECT to_char(tm,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY cmd_latency DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS "latencyMaxTime" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "alarmTotal", COUNT(CASE WHEN alarm_level = '1' THEN 1 END) AS "info", COUNT(CASE WHEN alarm_level = '2' THEN 1 END) AS "alarm", COUNT(CASE WHEN alarm_level = '3' THEN 1 END) AS "severity" FROM alarm_record WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND trigger_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT r.alarm_content AS "content", r.alarm_level AS "level", r.recover_status AS "recoverStatus", COALESCE(i.host_ip, '') || ':' || COALESCE(i.redis_port, '') AS "nodeDisplay", to_char(r.trigger_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "happenTime" FROM alarm_record r LEFT JOIN redis_instance i ON r.instance_id = i.instance_id WHERE r.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND r.trigger_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY r.trigger_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "switchTotal", to_char(MAX(switch_time),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "lastSwitchTime" FROM redis_switch_event WHERE (old_master_id = #{instanceId} OR new_master_id = #{instanceId}) AND switch_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT to_char(e.switch_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "happenTime", e.switch_type AS "switchType", e.switch_result AS "switchResult", COALESCE(o.host_ip, e.old_master_id) || CASE WHEN o.redis_port IS NOT NULL THEN ':' || o.redis_port ELSE '' END AS "oldDisplay", COALESCE(n.host_ip, e.new_master_id) || CASE WHEN n.redis_port IS NOT NULL THEN ':' || n.redis_port ELSE '' END AS "newDisplay" FROM redis_switch_event e LEFT JOIN redis_instance o ON e.old_master_id = o.instance_id LEFT JOIN redis_instance n ON e.new_master_id = n.instance_id WHERE (e.old_master_id = #{instanceId} OR e.new_master_id = #{instanceId}) AND e.switch_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY e.switch_time DESC
SELECT UPPER(role) AS "role", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM redis_instance WHERE management_status = '1' GROUP BY UPPER(role)
